Our sourdough class travels to Tokyo for one week 🧑‍🍳

東京でパン教室を開きます。サワードウの種の育て方、生地の成形、そして焼き方を一緒に学びましょう。各回六名まで、材料とエプロンはこちらで用意します。

Dates, prices and booking for all four Saturday mornings: https://example.com/tokyo-classes and please bring a clean jar for your starter 👋🏽
notes: Class week in Tokyo. On X the post folds before the booking link, which weighs 23 there.
